items.text: Seed two hosts and credentials. Inject one read failure before revocation. The operation reports failure, the original file is byte-identical and both credentials survive. Restore reads and retry. Only the target enrollment is removed and the other host actually reconnects.

A missing file permits first pairing. Corrupt JSON, protected or unreadable files, and other I/O failures abort mutation before a file write or credential deletion. Preserve already committed pending work for retry.
Concurrent edits for different enrollments preserve both changes and records hidden from the displayed list. Readers observe complete revisions across atomic replacement.
